scope: Read-only inspection of bot.py, prompt_engine.py and V9 cookware static QA on staging branch.

observations.finding: Jana Prompt takes category and product name; product image upload to Klippo is not required.
User is told to upload original product image to the external AI generator; Klippo does not automatically send it.
Identity rule explicitly expects original product photo(s) to be supplied to the target generator.
Prompt-generation path invokes build_prompt() with current user selections and optional storyboard override; this is not evidence that the V9 shortlist is directly loaded.
PROMPTS_BY_ID is constructed from PROMPT_LIBRARY; need trace its source and selection mapping before claiming V9 active.

decisions: Retain name-only Klippo flow and external-generator photo instruction.
Keep V9 shortlist as staging-only; do not activate or merge.
Do not remove product reference lock or replace it with fabricated product details.

Before integration, trace PROMPT_LIBRARY source and category/subcategory mapping, identify how standalone V9 prompts will be selected without generic recomposition, and add tests for 10s/20s and voice selection.
required_tests: Product name only in Klippo, original photo attached externally
50 shortlist concepts selectable without duplicate/rejected entries
Standalone prompt text not overwritten by generic build_prompt clauses
No deployment or activation of DRAFT_RENDER_QA records
